title: The Turntable
synopsis: The windmills stop, and the Hush rises on the line ahead. Rook runs the train backwards to an old turntable. But turning takes time.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Windmill hills tonight. Hold the bar.
Every light ahead is going out.
There! It's on the line, ahead of us!
It walks faster than we can run!
The old turntable. I have an idea.
Round we go, old table. Slowly...
The wind! The old mill is turning!
Now! Full steam! Hold on tight!
It will come again. We keep moving.
Next stop: the town past the hills.
